before.question: Which principle best characterizes posaconazole pseudoaldosteronism?
choices: Posaconazole can cause hypertension and hypokalemia through apparent mineralocorticoid excess
Renal implications differ between active drug clearance and an intravenous solubilizing vehicle
Target alteration, target overexpression, efflux, and pathway adaptation can reduce azole susceptibility
Conventional capsules are taken with a full meal and depend on gastric acidity, while oral solution is taken without food when possible

after.question: Which principle best characterizes posaconazole pseudoaldosteronism?
choices: Posaconazole can cause hypertension and hypokalemia through apparent mineralocorticoid excess
Pseudoaldosteronism requires elevated aldosterone and cannot occur with suppressed renin and aldosterone
Posaconazole-related mineralocorticoid excess raises potassium rather than lowering it
New hypertension during posaconazole excludes a drug-related cause if the patient already had hypertension
after.rationale: The current NOXAFIL warning identifies new or worsening hypertension with hypokalemia and reports low renin and aldosterone with elevated 11-deoxycortisol. Thus high aldosterone is not required, potassium may fall, and prior hypertension does not exclude worsening from a drug-associated syndrome. Postmarketing reports do not establish its frequency or prove causation in every patient.

teachingReview.heading: Recognize mineralocorticoid excess
teachingReview.before: Hypertension, hypokalemia, and metabolic alkalosis can signal posaconazole-associated pseudoaldosteronism. Blood pressure, potassium, bicarbonate, exposure, renin, aldosterone, and competing causes guide evaluation.
teachingReview.after: Hypertension, hypokalemia, and metabolic alkalosis can signal posaconazole-associated pseudoaldosteronism. Blood pressure, potassium, bicarbonate, exposure, renin, aldosterone, and competing causes guide evaluation. The current NOXAFIL label reports new or worsening hypertension, hypokalemia, low renin and aldosterone, and elevated 11-deoxycortisol in the postmarket setting. The FDA clinical review completed in May 2021 also describes metabolic alkalosis and reports associated with supratherapeutic posaconazole exposure during long-term use. Monitor blood pressure and potassium, characterize the acid-base pattern, and review the exact product, dose, interacting medicines and other possible causes. Hormone results and an interpretable drug concentration may help contextualize a suspected case; this is not a required fixed panel or a universal concentration cutoff. Pre-existing hypertension and concomitant steroids can complicate attribution. The pattern warrants evaluation rather than proving causation in every patient. Label-listed management options include discontinuing NOXAFIL, using an appropriate alternative antifungal not associated with pseudoaldosteronism, or an aldosterone-receptor antagonist; correct electrolyte disturbances as needed. Do not wait for every specialized result before monitoring or correcting the clinical abnormalities.

teachingReview.heading: Audit oral delivery
teachingReview.before: Meals, acid suppression, mucositis, vomiting, tube feeds, swallowing, access, and adherence can undermine an oral plan. Teach-back should include the exact product.
teachingReview.after: Meals, acid suppression, mucositis, vomiting, tube feeds, swallowing, access, and adherence can undermine an oral plan. Teach-back should include the exact product. Establish whether the patient can obtain and take the prescribed product and complete its nutrition and preparation instructions; mucositis and nausea are intake barriers to assess, not a uniform measured effect on antifungal pharmacokinetics. For example, NOXAFIL delayed-release tablets must be swallowed whole and may be taken with or without food, while conventional suspension requires the labeled meal or alternative nutrition plan, shaking and the provided measured spoon. Cimetidine and esomeprazole can lower conventional suspension exposure, and severe diarrhea or vomiting requires monitoring for breakthrough infection. A healthy-volunteer NG-tube study found lower suspension exposure; it does not define every tube, feeding schedule or feed-hold protocol, and whole-tablet instructions do not permit automatic crushing. PowderMix has separate with-food and kit-specific preparation instructions. Ask the patient or caregiver to explain the exact product, meal plan, permitted manipulation, measuring device and response to a missed dose or severe vomiting. Teach-back checks understanding of the plan; it does not prove absorption or replace product-specific clinical assessment.

wholeFinalLesson.title: Make Posaconazole Formulation Visible
wholeFinalLesson.summary: Delayed-release tablets, oral suspension, and PowderMix differ in indication, eligibility, dosing, preparation, and exposure.
wholeFinalLesson.application: Select the formulation before the dose, then protect administration, exposure, interactions, and electrolyte surveillance.

lesson.heading: Stop unsafe substitution
lesson.body: Conventional posaconazole oral suspension is not substitutable with delayed-release tablets or PowderMix. A product switch requires a new indication, eligibility, dose, administration, and monitoring verification rather than a copied milligram amount. The February 2026 NOXAFIL label specifies delayed-release tablets for invasive aspergillosis treatment or high-risk prophylaxis in patients aged at least two years who weigh more than 40 kg. PowderMix covers those indications in children aged at least two years weighing 10 to 40 kg. Conventional oral suspension covers high-risk prophylaxis and oropharyngeal candidiasis in patients aged at least 13 years. Follow the exact product and indication rather than transferring one eligibility rule to every formulation. PowderMix is contraindicated in known or suspected hereditary fructose intolerance and requires its kit-specific preparation and provided notched-tip syringes.

lesson.heading: Use the current tablet instruction
lesson.body: Delayed-release tablets are swallowed whole and may be taken with or without food. This differs from older generalized teaching that every posaconazole dose must accompany a meal. Do not divide, crush, or chew the tablets. For eligible patients who cannot eat a full meal, the label favors tablets over conventional suspension for prophylaxis because tablets generally provide higher exposure. Food flexibility does not guarantee absorption: monitor for breakthrough infection with severe diarrhea or vomiting. The tablet food study still found an exposure change with a high-fat meal.

lesson.heading: Protect suspension absorption
lesson.body: Oral suspension is given with a full meal or, when needed, a nutritional supplement or acidic carbonated beverage. Give each conventional suspension dose during or within 20 minutes after a full meal. If a full meal is not possible and tablets or injection are not options, use the labeled liquid nutritional supplement or acidic carbonated beverage, such as ginger ale. If these cannot be tolerated either, consider an alternative antifungal or closely monitored suspension therapy. Shake well and use the provided measured dosing spoon. Assess poor intake, acid suppression, nausea, mucositis, diarrhea, and tube feeding before relying on oral delivery. Cimetidine and esomeprazole can lower suspension exposure; severe diarrhea or vomiting requires breakthrough monitoring. A healthy-volunteer NG-tube study found lower suspension exposure, but does not define every tube or continuous-feed protocol. Mucositis and nausea prompt intake assessment rather than a claimed uniform pharmacokinetic effect. PowderMix has separate with-food instructions and kit-specific preparation.

lesson.heading: Recognize mineralocorticoid excess
lesson.body: Hypertension, hypokalemia, and metabolic alkalosis can signal posaconazole-associated pseudoaldosteronism. Blood pressure, potassium, bicarbonate, exposure, renin, aldosterone, and competing causes guide evaluation. The current NOXAFIL label reports new or worsening hypertension, hypokalemia, low renin and aldosterone, and elevated 11-deoxycortisol in the postmarket setting. The FDA clinical review completed in May 2021 also describes metabolic alkalosis and reports associated with supratherapeutic posaconazole exposure during long-term use. Monitor blood pressure and potassium, characterize the acid-base pattern, and review the exact product, dose, interacting medicines and other possible causes. Hormone results and an interpretable drug concentration may help contextualize a suspected case; this is not a required fixed panel or a universal concentration cutoff. Pre-existing hypertension and concomitant steroids can complicate attribution. The pattern warrants evaluation rather than proving causation in every patient. Label-listed management options include discontinuing NOXAFIL, using an appropriate alternative antifungal not associated with pseudoaldosteronism, or an aldosterone-receptor antagonist; correct electrolyte disturbances as needed. Do not wait for every specialized result before monitoring or correcting the clinical abnormalities.

all18FinalQuestionObjects.question: Which assessment is most appropriate for posaconazole pseudoaldosteronism?
choices: Assess blood pressure, potassium, bicarbonate, renin, aldosterone, posaconazole concentration, and interacting causes
Measure blood pressure only because potassium and the acid-base pattern are unrelated to this syndrome
Interpret one drug concentration as definitive proof and omit competing medicines or causes
Require elevated renin and aldosterone before considering posaconazole-associated pseudoaldosteronism
all18FinalQuestionObjects.rationale: Assess blood pressure and potassium first, then use bicarbonate to characterize possible metabolic alkalosis and interpret renin, aldosterone, drug exposure and competing causes in clinical context. The current label reports low renin and aldosterone with elevated 11-deoxycortisol; the FDA 2021 review describes alkalosis and reports associated with supratherapeutic posaconazole levels. Blood pressure alone misses the electrolyte pattern. One concentration cannot prove causation, and high renin or aldosterone is not required. This is a contextual assessment, not a mandatory fixed testing panel or a universal drug-level threshold.

all18FinalQuestionObjects.question: Which reasoning hazard is most important to prevent with posaconazole pseudoaldosteronism?
choices: Attributing the entire pattern to essential hypertension
Checking the potassium and bicarbonate pattern alongside new or worsening hypertension
Reviewing posaconazole exposure and competing causes before assigning causation
Interpreting renin and aldosterone in context rather than requiring them to be elevated
all18FinalQuestionObjects.rationale: Essential hypertension alone should not explain away new or worsening hypertension paired with hypokalemia and possible metabolic alkalosis during posaconazole use. Reviewing electrolytes, exposure, hormones and competing causes helps evaluate the drug-safety signal; these are appropriate actions, not the hazard. Prior hypertension or concomitant steroids can complicate attribution, and temporal association alone does not establish causation.

all18FinalQuestionObjects.question: A prescription switches posaconazole delayed-release tablets to oral suspension at the same milligram dose. What should happen?
choices: Stop and redesign the regimen because the formulations are not substitutable
Dispense without review
Crush both products together
Assume identical exposure
all18FinalQuestionObjects.rationale: Stop the dose-for-dose substitution and verify the new product's indication, eligibility, regimen and administration. Conventional oral suspension is not substitutable with delayed-release tablets because dosing and exposure differ. Dispensing unchanged or assuming equal exposure is unsupported, and crushing the delayed-release tablet is explicitly prohibited.

all18FinalQuestionObjects.question: A patient on posaconazole develops hypertension, hypokalemia, and metabolic alkalosis. What syndrome should be evaluated?
choices: Posaconazole-associated pseudoaldosteronism
Essential hypertension alone, with no need to explain potassium loss or alkalosis
Posaconazole underexposure established solely by the hypertension and electrolyte pattern
Aldosterone excess that is excluded unless both renin and aldosterone are elevated
all18FinalQuestionObjects.rationale: This combination should prompt evaluation for posaconazole-associated pseudoaldosteronism. The FDA 2021 clinical review describes hypertension, hypokalemia and metabolic alkalosis, while the current label reports new or worsening hypertension, hypokalemia, low renin and aldosterone, and elevated 11-deoxycortisol. Essential hypertension alone is not an adequate explanation for the complete pattern; the pattern does not prove underexposure, and elevated renin or aldosterone is not required. Review drug exposure and competing causes rather than treating the triad as definitive proof.
